description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Drawings) of planning permission 00845/21/P3 dated 04/07/2018 (Demolition of existing house and erection of a new semi-detached house) to allow additional 1 metre depth for single storey rear wing.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission 00845/21/P3 dated 04/07/2018.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning Statement dated May 2019, and Drawings 1/16, 1/17, received: 08/05/2019. 25 Rev C, 26 Rev D, 27 Rev D, and 28 Rev B received: 26/06/2019. Drawings 1/15 Rev B and 29 Rev A received: 01/07/2019.
Drawings approved under 00845/21/P3:
3, 5, KRS.0237.001.R.002.A, Design and Access Statement, and KRS.0237.001.R.001.A, received 23/04/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the development hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.
Condition : 5 - The materials used in the construction of the dwelling hereby approved shall match those at No 23 Oxford Avenue.

Condition : 6 - Demolition or construction works shall take place only between 0800 -1800 on Mondays to Fridays, 0900 - 1300 on Saturdays and shall not take place at any time on Sundays or on Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the energy statement as submitted in this application, no development shall take place until a revised energy statement supported by SAP calculations, demonstrating how the target 35% carbon dioxide emissions reduction on Part L 2013 is to be met in line with the Mayor's energy hierarchy and including details of the risk of overheating, the cooling hierarchy and proposed technologies, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The energy statement approved shall be put into effect and evidence supplied (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) to the local planning authority to demonstrate that this has been done before the dwelling is first occupied.

Condition : 8 - (i) No development shall take place until the details of a Sustainable Urban Drainage scheme (SUDs), including measures for (i) the harvesting of rainwater, (ii) the minimisation of water run-off from the site, aiming for greenfield levels, and (iii) the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the buildings have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
(ii) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 9 - The development shall be designed so that Internal water consumption shall not exceed 105 l/p/day for each flat, in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government.

Condition : 10 - Prior to first occupation of the building, evidence shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the required sustainable materials:
(i) At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
(ii) At least 50% of timber and timber products are sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) schemes
(iii) No construction or insulation materials have been used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 11 - A splay of 2.4 m x 2.4 m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6 m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 12 - Prior to occupation of the building details of the proposed hard and soft landscaping areas and boundary fencing, specifying the species of planting, together with a maintenance schedule for the first five years shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The landscaping and planting works shall be completed no later than the first available planting season after first occupation of any part of the development.  Within the first five years, any plants that die or are removed shall be replaced in the first available planting season thereafter.

Condition : 13 - The development shall not be occupied until full details of secure covered cycle parking provision (including enclosure details) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and installed. This shall provide two spaces and these shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 14 - Before the dwelling hereby approved is first occupied, the developer shall provide the dwelling with a garden waste composting bin of at least 220 litres capacity, a green box container and any other type of containers required at the time of development for household use for the storage and collection of recyclable materials for the purposes of the Council's kerbside recycling service, to the specification then in use by the local authority's recycling collection service (or to such other specification as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority) and shall notify the Council's refuse and recycling services when the development is first occupied.  The waste and recyclable materials containers shall be stored in a proprietary refuse bin enclosure designed for the purpose to be supplied by the developer and located adjacent to the dwelling.
